home.heroTitle: Learner pays → Discord opens. Refund → access cut.
home.heroBody: Not MEE6. Discelyn wires your training Stripe to a Discord role: OAuth claim, dated cohort, auto-revoke. Free trial includes 1 access product.
home.stepsSubtitle: Built for training organisations — not hobby communities.
home.step1Body: OAuth login, then create your bot config in the dashboard.
home.step2Body: Your training Price ID → Learner role. Webhook on your Stripe account.
home.step3Body: Payment → Discord claim → role. Refund or sub end → access removed.
home.diffTitle: MEE6 / Carl entertain. Discelyn gates access.
home.diffPublicBody: Welcome, tickets, levels, music — zero link to your payments.
home.diffDiscelynBody: Your Stripe → Discord role, learner claim, cohort, refund/sub revoke. EU invoice.
home.diffProof1Body: Webhook on YOUR Stripe. discelyn_price_id metadata or line_items read.
home.diffProof2Body: Learner connects Discord — role applied, or one-shot invite if not on the server yet.
home.diffProof3Body: Refund, subscription end or cohort end → role removed. Timeline in dashboard.
home.pricingSubtitle: Start free or at €19.99. Diagnostic / setup optional.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to upgrade your training server?
home.ctaBody: Free trial. Or ask a question — reply within 1 business day.

preview.ticketBody: Private channel created. Staff notified. History kept.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Core: Stripe payment → Discord role. The rest (welcome, tickets, mods) is ops glue — not the differentiator.
features.whySubtitle: One brick MEE6 doesn’t have, plus the minimum to run a training Discord.
features.ctaTitle: Ready to wire Stripe to Discord?
features.ctaBody: Trial: 1 access product. Configure from the dashboard.

access.d: Webhook on YOUR Stripe. Learner pays, claims Discord, gets the role. Refund = access cut.
access.detail: That’s the difference vs MEE6 / Carl: they entertain; you gate access.

welcome.d: Welcome message + cohort role on join — useful, not unique.
welcome.detail: Ops glue. Every bot does this; in Discelyn it’s secondary to paid access.

mod.d: Warns in DB + preview; audit export from Starter.
mod.detail: Useful for disputes — complement, not the wedge.

rgpd.d: Account export / delete, retention, Stripe EUR.
rgpd.detail: Org framing — invisible in Discord, useful to close deals.

dashboard.d: Configure Stripe→role and ops without pasting a token.
dashboard.detail: First useful screen: access control, not a hobby module grid.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No server to host, no token to paste: sign in, link your guild, configure.
howItWorks.stepsSubtitle: From Discord login to a live server — the same path as in the product.
howItWorks.scrollHint: Scroll or click a step above
howItWorks.needsSubtitle: Nothing exotic — just Discord and a few minutes.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Configure from the dashboard, upgrade via Stripe when you want. No tokens to manage.

01.d: Click Try and sign in with Discord. No Discelyn password: Discord OAuth, secure session.

02.d: In the dashboard, create a Discelyn config. Trial already ships the ops core (welcome, roles, tickets, logs, moderation, FAQ); audit export unlocks with Starter.

03.t: Invite the bot to your server
03.d: Pick your guild, invite the platform bot. Discord asks for permissions — link from the dashboard.

04.d: Welcome, roles, tickets, moderation: all from the dashboard. Runtime reloads — your server runs.

account.d: The one you use to manage the training server.

server.d: Your community / cohort — with permission to invite a bot.

time.d: Login → config → invite → modules. Upgrade whenever.

dashboard.wedgeBody: Until Stripe→role is set up, Discelyn looks like a generic bot. Wire access: that’s the product.
dashboard.setupBody: Four steps. Welcome and tickets come later — the product is Stripe → Discord role.
dashboard.setupStepBotBody: One bot config for your training server.
dashboard.setupStepGuildBody: Invite Discelyn and attach the guild.
dashboard.setupStepStripeBody: On your Stripe account — no Discelyn cut.
dashboard.readyBody: Stripe → role is wired. Share the payment link, test a claim, then add welcome / tickets if needed.
dashboard.emptyBotsBody: Create your first config, then follow the checklist above.
dashboard.botsIntro: Priority: access control (Stripe→role). Ops (welcome, tickets…) sits below.
dashboard.trialValueHint: The diff vs MEE6 = the Access control panel below. Without Stripe wired, you’re just a generic bot — wire it.
dashboard.deleteBotConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? The bot will leave the linked server. This cannot be undone.
dashboard.botsSubtitle: Invite the platform bot, then link your server.
dashboard.gdprBody: Export your data (portability) or delete your account (erasure).
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete your account, bots and data? This cannot be undone.
dashboard.deleteConfirmStep: Confirm deletion. Irreversible: bots, training access, and account data.
dashboard.deleteMfaCodeRequired: 2FA code required to delete the account.
dashboard.cookieConsentIntro: History of your cookie choices (GDPR evidence). Change anytime via the Cookies link in the footer.
dashboard.cookieConsentEmpty: No consent recorded for this account yet.

dashboard.checklistAccessFirst: Priority: wire Stripe → role below. Welcome / tickets come after.
dashboard.accessNeedsGuild: Link the server and invite the bot to configure payment → role access.
dashboard.pastDueBody: Your subscription is PAST_DUE. Paid features may be limited until payment is updated.
dashboard.ownerMfaBody: Checkout, plan changes, Stripe portal, team and training Stripe keys require 2FA.

dashboard.guildLimit: Limit: {count, plural, one {# server} other {# servers}}
dashboard.identityHint: The name becomes Discelyn’s nickname on your Discord server (member list). The description stays internal to the dashboard.

dashboard.billingIntro: Payments are handled by Stripe. You can change or cancel anytime.
dashboard.billingSuccess: Payment confirmed. Your plan will update within a few seconds.
dashboard.billingDpa: Scale DPA: template available on request (docs/DPA.md) — not a signed in-app PDF. Contact support for the contractual process before signing.
dashboard.billingAuditHint: Moderation audit export: each bot page → “History & audit export” section.
dashboard.changePlanIntro: Pick a plan. If you already have a Stripe subscription, the change is prorated immediately.
dashboard.changePlanFreeViaPortal: Downgrade to free via the Stripe portal (cancel).

dashboard.invoicesIntro: Paid Stripe invoices — downloadable as PDF.
dashboard.accountIntro: Profile, organization, preferences, security, billing and data.
dashboard.accountDiscordHint: Identity is managed via Discord OAuth — no Discelyn password.
dashboard.mfaIntro: After Discord login, an Authenticator code is required. Protects the dashboard even if Discord is compromised.
dashboard.mfaScanHint: Add Discelyn in Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password with the key below, then enter the 6-digit code.
dashboard.mfaRecoveryBody: Store these offline. Each code works once. They will not be shown again.

dashboard.prefsIntro: Theme, language and timezone for date display.

dashboard.sessionsIntro: Devices signed in to your Discelyn account.

access.title: Learner access control
access.wizardBody: Paste your Stripe key → price + role → post the Discord shop. Webhook + Payment Link auto. 0% Discelyn fee.
access.needGuild: Link your Discord server first (step above).
access.step1Body: Secret key from YOUR training Stripe (not Discelyn’s). We create the webhook for you.
access.step1Hint: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys. Prefer a restricted key with Products + Webhooks + Payment Links.
access.step2Body: Pick price + Discord role, and optionally a shop pitch + welcome DM.
access.pitchPlaceholder: Lifetime access to premium channels + weekly Q&A
access.welcomeDmPlaceholder: Welcome! Read #start and open a ticket if needed.
access.onboardingPlaceholder:
Read #rules
Introduce yourself in #intro
Open /ticket if needed
access.noPrices: No active prices in Stripe — create a Product + Price in your Stripe dashboard.
access.step3Body: Share the link, or post the Discord shop (Buy buttons). Members can also run /boutique.
access.shopBody: Embed + Payment Link buttons in a channel — no external page to explain.
access.boutiqueHint: On the server: /boutique shows the same links.
access.stripeBody: Webhook URL to paste in your Stripe dashboard (Developers → Webhooks), or created automatically via the secret key.
access.stripeHint: Prefer the 1-click setup above. Here you can paste whsec_ / sk_ manually if you manage the webhook yourself.

learners.title: Learners
learners.revokeConfirm: Revoke this learner’s access? This cannot be undone.
learners.emptyHint: Learners appear after a training Stripe payment (or an access code).

health.title: Server health
health.body: Bot permissions, role hierarchy, channels — catch silent grant failures.

accessStats.title: Access stats
accessStats.pendingHintBody: Often: learner has not claimed yet, or bot lacks role permission / hierarchy. Check learners and guild health.
accessStats.oversoldBody: Checkout charged while the product was sold out — automatic refund attempted.

affiliates.title: Affiliates (tracking)
affiliates.body: Marketing attribution only: clicks + linked conversions. Discelyn neither calculates nor pays commissions — the bps field is a memo for your internal reporting.
affiliates.label: Label
affiliates.emptyHint: Create a code to track clicks and conversions on your /r/… links.

webhooks.title: Outbound webhooks
webhooks.body: HMAC-signed POST (X-Discelyn-Signature) to Make / Zapier / Notion.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add a Zapier / Make URL to receive access events.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.bannerBody: Essential cookies (session, language, theme, choice, visitor ID) keep the site working. You can enable analytics, Sentry and affiliate separately. No third-party ads.
cookies.prefsBody: Choose each optional category. You can withdraw consent anytime. Essential cookies remain required.
cookies.essentialDesc: Session, language, theme, cookie choice, visitor ID (consent evidence). Always on.
cookies.analyticsDesc: First-party events (landing views, signup, checkout…). No third-party ads.
cookies.sentryDesc: Browser error diagnostics when Sentry is configured.
cookies.affiliateDesc: discelyn_aff cookie to attribute referrals (30 days).
cookies.optionalDesc: Browser Sentry, product analytics, affiliate cookie.

claim.title: Claim your Discord access
claim.subtitle: You paid for training — connect Discord to get your role.
claim.sessionPendingBody: Your access arrives in a few seconds. This page refreshes itself. If nothing happens, use the link from your training support.
claim.sessionTimeoutBody: The Stripe webhook is taking longer than expected. Try again, or contact your training support with your payment reference.
claim.sessionSoldOutBody: Payment was received while the training was full. Contact your training support — a refund should follow.
claim.sessionSoldOutRefunded: The training was full: your payment was refunded automatically. You will not be charged.
claim.privacyHint: Discelyn only reads your Discord ID to grant the role. No messages, no acting as you.
claim.successActive: Access active — your role is on the server.
claim.successJoin: Almost — join the server to receive your role.
claim.codeSubtitle: Enter the code from your training org.
claim.portalFailed: Stripe portal unavailable. Contact your training support.
